scope: Two source histories only: LoCoMo conv-49 and exposed LME DEV12 history d6062bb9. These are not benchmark/official scores.
final_decision: Neither candidate is promoted; retain the original frozen paper methods. No gate retrofit, tuning or rerun.

interpretation.locomo: Whole-set source QA likelihood and F1 improved, but all four source-audit contexts changed and audit likelihood/F1 declined; the declared gate returned exactly Seed.
interpretation.longmemeval: The pilot adopted two options: two of ten QA packed contexts changed, with macro likelihood delta +0.0042460375 and unchanged QA F1. All four audit inputs were identical; their raw +0.0004155367 difference is not an evidence improvement.
interpretation.qb: LoCoMo has three identical Seed/final inputs and unchanged F1. Its raw negative likelihood difference cannot indicate memory harm. LME has one changed-evidence QB with negative likelihood delta and one identical-input QB; aggregate F1 stayed 1.0. Neither supports promotion.
interpretation.identical_input_variation: Raw deltas are preserved. Identical context/user/answer pairs can differ in these recorded NLL outputs. The frozen scorer schedules duplicate uncached keys before filling its cache, consistent with repeated-input/batch numerical variation; exact kernel causation is not established. No score or gate is corrected retrospectively.

cost_scope: New source-view generation/calibration, source likelihood/answer generation, and CPU MiniLM indexing, including post-lock source QB. Imported Seed/source-probe/source-utility costs are additional and excluded here.
observed_teardown_logs: Both engines logged Shutdown complete, followed by an Engine core died unexpectedly client teardown line/NCCL destruction warning. Stage exit codes were zero, all completion/usage bindings passed, no failed native calls were recorded, and no GPU worker remained at quiescence check. Original logs are preserved.
